stock.description: Lap Kei Engineering (Holdings) Limited, a Hong Kong-based investment holding firm, primarily focuses on the installation and design of building services infrastructure and related undertakings. The company's operations are categorized into two principal divisions. The Building Services Engineering Work segment provides comprehensive engineering solutions for various building systems, including those related to ventilation, air-conditioning, electrical power, plumbing and drainage, fire safety, and other essential building facilities. Its second division, Maintenance, Repair and Other Services, is dedicated to servicing and restoring these building systems, along with the provision of replacement parts. The company predominantly conducts its business activities within Hong Kong.
